title: Prompt Generasi Visual Edukasi
html:
Berikut kumpulan prompt gambar instruksional untuk mendukung visualisasi modul:

  1. Struktur Public Speaking:
Educational infographic showing public speaking structure: Hook -> Opening -> Main Content -> Closing, Indonesian high school student presenter, clean modern classroom, simple visual hierarchy, realistic educational poster, 16:9 landscape.
  1. Elemen Suara (Vocal Delivery):
Educational infographic about voice delivery showing articulation, intonation, tempo, volume, and pause, Indonesian student presenter, clean classroom setting, simple instructional design, realistic photography combined with infographic labels, 16:9.
  1. Presenter di Depan Kamera:
Educational photography showing Indonesian high school student acting as a presenter in front of a smartphone camera on a tripod, proper eye contact, natural posture, controlled hand gestures, simple classroom background, realistic school environment, 16:9.
  1. Teknik Wawancara Lapangan:
Educational photography showing two Indonesian high school students conducting a simple interview, one holding a microphone and asking questions, the other answering, smartphone camera on tripod recording them, natural classroom environment, realistic documentary style, 16:9.
  1. Proses Pengisian Voice Over:
Educational infographic explaining voice over production, showing student recording voice with microphone while video footage appears on a laptop timeline, arrows connecting voice recording to video editing, clean modern classroom, realistic educational style, 16:9.
  1. Pengaturan Framing Talking Head:
Educational photography showing correct talking head video setup for a student, smartphone mounted on tripod, student framed from chest upward, camera at eye level, soft natural lighting, clean background, proper headroom and eye contact, Indonesian high school environment, 16:9.
  1. Bahasa Tubuh Positif vs Negatif:
Educational infographic showing good and bad body language during public speaking, Indonesian high school student, examples of upright posture, natural gesture, looking at camera, compared with slouching, looking down, excessive gestures, clean instructional design, 16:9.
